mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(actual_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM `order` WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM member WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM member WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(points), 0) FROM member_points_record WHERE points > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM member WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND expiry_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(actual_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND status = 1 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT ml.level_name AS name, COUNT(m.id) AS value FROM member_level ml LEFT JOIN member m ON ml.id = m.current_level_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ml.id, ml.level_name ORDER BY ml.sort_order

SELECT oi.product_name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS amount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 1 GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT pc.category_name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS value FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 1 INNER JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id GROUP BY pc.id, pc.category_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(1) AS count FROM member WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT id, name, phone FROM member WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND birthday IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(birthday, '%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%m-%d')
SELECT id, name, phone, expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM member WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND expiry_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY expiry_date

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(actual_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM `order` WHERE status = 1
AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_statistics (stat_date, total_order_count, total_amount, total_member_count, new_member_count, points_issued, points_consumed) SELECT #{statDate}, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `order` WHERE status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = #{statDate}), (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = #{statDate}), (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM member WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) <= #{statDate}), (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM member WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{statDate}), (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(points), 0) FROM member_points_record WHERE points > 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{statDate}), (SELECT IFNULL(ABS(SUM(points)), 0) FROM member_points_record WHERE points < 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{statDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_order_count = VALUES(total_order_count), total_amount = VALUES(total_amount), total_member_count = VALUES(total_member_count), new_member_count = VALUES(new_member_count), points_issued = VALUES(points_issued), points_consumed = VALUES(points_consumed)
